SQLite amalgamation 3.54.0
Upstream: https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540000.zip
Upstream ZIP SHA3-256: 7b670a62fdfbd672b75fef004cb703c8a3e87d3a5cc7d675b4a08337004a2d93
Only sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h are included, unchanged.
License: public domain. https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html
Build scripts from other SQLite archives are not included.
The generated ArmadaSqlite.dll exports the standard SQLite C API.
